 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The New York Giants (3-2-1) will continue their regular season slate against the Houston Texans (2-4) on Sunday afternoon at Reliant Stadium in Houston, Texas.
 Injuries continue to be a theme for the Giants, who saw their injury report swell to 16 players throughout the week, including seven who missed at least one practice. The largest concerns comes at tackle, where Andrew Thomas, Jermaine Eluemunor, and Marcus Mbow are all ailing.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "There's no indication that any of the tackles are long-term," head coach John Harbaugh said when asked about their status.
 Meanwhile, cornerback Paulson Adebo will be activated from injured reserve (IR) and play on Sunday.
 Full injury reports for the Giants and Texans can be found below:
 New York Giants
 Out : LB Tremaine Edmunds (shoulder), CB Greh Newsome II (concussion)
 Doubtful : TE Theo Johnson (beck)
 Questionable : CB Paulson Adebo (knee), RT Jermaine Eluemunor (calf), S Jevon Holland (concussion), OL Marcus Mbow (knee), S Tyler Nubin (neck)
 Houston Texans
 Out : N/A
 Doubtful : N/A
 Questionable : N/A
